svg.text: I Ching: read by period, no cellsThe I Ching is read by period, not by year: ask for a window of at most 62 days to see its character, which includes the lines that name goods or an audience with a superior.
Each line is what a named rule of one tradition says about
this period, with its source. Nobody has tested these
